newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Smurfit buys two German companies.
newsitem.headline: Smurfit buys two German companies.

text.p: Jefferson Smurfit Group Plc said on Wednesday that it was acquiring two companies in Germany for a total consideration of 29.7 million punts including acquired debt.
Wellit GmbH Wellpappenfabrik, located near Dortmund, and Schneverdinger Wellpappenwerk GmbH & Co. KG, located between Hamburg and Hanover, manufacture and distribute corrugated boxes and board.

"The acquisitions reinforce our position as a leading producer of corrugated boxes in Europe and enhance our ability to service the European market," Pat Barrett, chief executive officer of Smurfit Europe, said in a statement.
"It is a good acquisition for Smurfit and Smurfit Europe expects to achieve additional downstream profitability from the integration of our German mill downstream into converting."
Smurfit said aggregate production in both plants in 1996 was 75,000 tonnes and, following recent investment programmes, they have a combined capacity of 90,000 tonnes.
Smurfit said the acquisitions were an important step toward achieving the twin goals of vertical integration and expansion in one of the largest regional markets in Europe.
